name: bloomScroll
oneLine: A Chrome extension that hides off-topic YouTube videos, decided on your own computer.

case.title: A YouTube filter that *shows* what it can’t judge.
case.lede: You open YouTube to learn something and the feed pulls you somewhere else. bloomScroll is a Chrome extension that hides the off-topic videos. By default it decides on your own computer, so nothing you watch is sent anywhere.

result.label: Time for a test feed to settle
result.note: Self-measured: 40-title test feed, 2017 dual-core MacBook Pro

facts.note: Every number here is my own measurement on a 40-title test feed, not field data.

case.pattern: a cascade, cheapest confident stage first

details.title: Fail open
details.chose: Show a video when no model answers
details.because: A wrongly hidden video costs more than a missed distraction

details.title: Embeddings in the browser
details.because: Titles never leave the computer, and it works offline
